message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, black, block letters above the subtitle "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". At the top, white text reads "MENGAPA RUU CIPTA KERJA DIKEBUT DI SENAYAN" and "SENGKETA ADAT DI LAHAN SINAR MAS", separated by a diagonal line.

The main image depicts a person in a white long-sleeved garment, wearing a surgical mask, a clear face shield, and light-colored gloves. This individual holds a hair clipper, which is connected by a black cord to an unseen power source. The person is positioned to the right, leaning over a large, pinkish-red sphere covered in rounded protrusions, resembling a stylized virus. The person is using the clippers on the top of this sphere, which sits in a dark, curved chair.

To the left, white text states: "SIMALAKAMA NORMAL BARU" followed by a paragraph of smaller text. In the background, a barbershop setting includes a pole with red and blue spirals, a mirror reflecting several small framed portraits, and a window. A barcode and a QR code are visible in the lower corners. Additional text in the bottom right corner includes "1-7 JUNI 2020", "RP 45.000", and an ISSN number.
